intro: Regional, simple and ingredient-first: a few great ingredients treated with respect. Every region swears its version is the real one.
flavours: Olive oil, tomato, garlic, basil, Parmigiano, pasta
hk: Italian is one of Hong Kong's most popular cuisines, from neighbourhood pizzerias to Michelin-starred Otto e Mezzo.

dishes.name: Pizza Margherita
dishes.what: Neapolitan pizza in the colours of the Italian flag, with a blistered, soft crust.

dishes.name: Spaghetti carbonara
dishes.what: Roman pasta coated in a silky sauce of egg, cheese and crispy pork. No cream in the real thing.

dishes.name: Cacio e pepe
dishes.what: Roman pasta with just cheese and pepper, emulsified with pasta water.

dishes.name: Lasagne
dishes.what: Layers of flat pasta, meat ragù and béchamel.

dishes.name: Risotto alla milanese
dishes.what: Golden, creamy rice coloured with saffron.

dishes.name: Ossobuco
dishes.what: Cross-cut veal shank with the marrow bone in the middle, in a wine sauce topped with gremolata.

dishes.name: Bistecca alla fiorentina
dishes.what: Huge T-bone steak from Florence, always served rare.

dishes.name: Arancini
dishes.what: Sicilian deep-fried rice balls stuffed with ragù or cheese.

dishes.name: Pesto alla genovese
dishes.what: Ligurian basil sauce pounded with pine nuts, usually tossed with trofie pasta.

dishes.name: Burrata
dishes.what: Ball of fresh mozzarella with a soft, creamy heart of stracciatella.

dishes.name: Tiramisu
dishes.what: Layered dessert of coffee-soaked biscuits and mascarpone cream.

dishes.name: Gelato
dishes.what: Italian ice cream: denser, silkier and less airy than American ice cream.
